title: an @AGENTS.md inside a code span or a fenced block is not an import: CLAUDE.md still gets the block
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup instructions, defect N-18): a delimited, reversible JITSO block in the instruction files agents read
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-18, setup instructions). Claude Code does not follow an `@path` inside a code span or a code block, so a `CLAUDE.md` that only quotes `@AGENTS.md` that way does not import it. The block is written to both files. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.
